Chickpea and Spinach Coconut Curry with Rice

Ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, 2 cups spinach, 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 inch ginger, 1 can coconut milk, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp curry powder, oil, salt, cooked rice.

Sauté chopped onion in oil for 5 minutes, then add garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Stir in curry powder and tomato paste.
Add coconut milk and chickpeas, simmer 10 minutes.
Add spinach until wilted, season with salt.
Serve over rice.

Overnight oats: stir 1/2 cup rolled oats, 1/2 cup milk or yogurt, and a spoonful of honey in a jar. This needs to soak, so for a true 10-minute option, use the instant version below.

Instant yogurt bowl: top 1 cup thick yogurt with sliced banana, a handful of nuts, and a drizzle of honey. It takes about 3 minutes.

Peanut butter banana toast: toast bread in a toaster, spread with peanut butter, and top with banana slices. It takes about 5 minutes.

Egg fried rice is the easiest: cook the rice, scramble the eggs in a hot pan, add the rice, and season with salt.

Mild chicken biryani (serves 4):

Marinate 500g chicken with 1 cup yogurt, 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp garam masala, 1/2 tsp Kashmiri chilli powder (for colour, mild), and salt for 30 minutes.
Parboil 2 cups soaked basmati with whole spices (bay leaf, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon) and salt until 70% cooked, then drain.
Fry 2 sliced onions until golden brown. Set half aside.
Cook the marinated chicken with half the onions for 10 minutes. Skip green chillies.
Layer the rice over the chicken. Top with the remaining onions, mint, coriander, and a splash of saffron milk and ghee.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat for 20 minutes.

Paneer Butter Masala (4 servings)

Ingredients: 250 g paneer, 3 tomatoes, 1 onion, 10 cashews, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 2 tbsp butter, 1 tsp Kashmiri chilli powder, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp kasuri methi, 1/4 cup cream, salt, sugar.

Boil onion, tomatoes and cashews in water for 10 minutes, then blend into a smooth puree.
Heat butter, add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the puree, chilli powder and salt; cook 8-10 minutes until the butter separates.
Add paneer cubes, garam masala, crushed kasuri methi and a pinch of sugar; simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in cream and turn off the heat.
